comparisons.reason: Same core construct (any comment quoting OP title/argument, endorsement not required), but the null rules differ materially. Spec 0 returns null only if OC_comments is bad or both title and argument are missing, and it allows a positive match from the available OP text. Spec 88 returns null if either title or argument is missing. Spec 88's empty-list rule is also contradictory (null versus 0), and it omits the explicit moderator/bot exclusion.
